brief:
Israeli occupation forces bulldozed agricultural land Saturday in the Jabal al-Salama area of Raba village, east of Jenin in northern West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The operation targeted farming plots in a region dotted with Israeli settlement infrastructure.

The bulldozing occurred near an active settlement outpost. Israeli forces have intensified land seizures in the Jenin area in recent months, with Palestinian farmers reporting repeated incursions onto their property.
